newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - July 1.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:
* At the stroke of midnight, Communist China resumed control of Hong Kong after a 156-year absence when the territory was under British rule.
* U.S. President Bill Clinton issued a counter proposal of $135 billion in tax cuts over five years, seeking a compromise with the Republican-controlled Congress.

* New laws around the United States designed to keep a short leash on convicted sex-offenders has sometimes ensnared people whose crimes do not meet the traditional definition of sex crimes, such as a closeted 63-year-old gay man who in the 1950s was arrested for having oral sex in a parked car.
* It was a busy term for the U.S. Supreme Court, which issued ruling after ruling that set new standards.
